question: When was the last f1 season whereby Brands Hatch hosted the British Grand Prix?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "races_enriched" AS WITH pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    raceid,
    MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'name' THEN value END) AS name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'year' THEN TRY_CAST(value AS INTEGER) END) AS year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'circuitId' THEN TRY_CAST(value AS INTEGER) END) AS circuitid
  FROM table_2
  WHERE attribute IN ('name','year','circuitId')
  GROUP BY raceid
)
SELECT
  p.raceid,
  p.name,
  p.circuitid,
  c.name AS circuit_name,
  p.year
FROM pivoted p
LEFT JOIN table_1 c
  ON p.circuitid = c.circuitid
WHERE p.name IS NOT NULL AND p.year IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  MAX(year) AS last_season_year
FROM races_enriched
WHERE name ILIKE '%British Grand Prix%'
  AND circuit_name ILIKE '%Brands Hatch%'
